reports.title: Farmer Payouts
reports.description: What each farmer is owed for the period, with M-Pesa or bank details, for paying farmers.

reports.title: Farmer Statement
reports.description: Every delivery by one farmer, with price and amount. To give to the farmer.

reports.title: Milk Collections
reports.description: Every intake in the period: farmer, litres, price, amount and collector.

reports.title: Milk Sales
reports.description: Every sale in the period: customer, litres, price, amount paid and owed.

reports.title: Customer Statement
reports.description: One customer's sales and payments with the running balance. To send to the customer.

reports.title: Customers Owing
reports.description: Every customer who owes the Sacco money, largest first.

reports.title: Milk Balance by Collector
reports.description: For each collector: collected, received, sold, transferred, spoiled and unaccounted litres.

reports.title: Sacco Summary
reports.description: Day by day: milk in and out, cost of milk, sales revenue and margin, with totals.

reports.title: Farmer Register
reports.description: All farmers with contacts, payout details, next of kin and status.
